# shopify_shop_locale (Resource)

A locale enabled on the shop. Publish it to make it visible to buyers; link it to markets with `default_locale` and `alternate_locales` on `shopify_web_presence`, which owns that relation. Disabling a locale deletes all translations of it, so destroying one needs `allow_data_deletion = true`. The primary locale can't be changed or disabled through the API: set `adopt_existing = true` to manage its entry, destroy only removes it from state. Import with the locale code, such as `fr` or `pt-BR`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shopify_shop_locale" "fr" {
  locale    = "fr"
  published = true
}

# Disabling a locale deletes its translations, so destroy needs allow_data_deletion = true in state.
resource "shopify_shop_locale" "it" {
  locale              = "it"
  allow_data_deletion = true
}

# The primary locale can't be changed or disabled, only adopted. Destroy removes it from state.
resource "shopify_shop_locale" "primary" {
  locale         = "de"
  adopt_existing = true
}

resource "shopify_web_presence" "ch" {
  subfolder_suffix  = "ch"
  default_locale    = shopify_shop_locale.primary.locale
  alternate_locales = [shopify_shop_locale.fr.locale]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `locale` (String) Locale code, case-sensitive: `fr`, `pt-BR`. Changing it replaces the locale and deletes the translations of the old one.

### Optional

- `adopt_existing` (Boolean) Take over an existing shop locale with the same natural key instead of failing. Destroy then only removes it from state. Defaults to `false`.
- `allow_data_deletion` (Boolean) Allow destroying or replacing this shop locale (its translations), which deletes the data stored in it. Defaults to `false`. Must already be `true` in state when the delete runs, so set it in a separate apply first.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether buyers can see the locale. A new locale starts unpublished. Unset means unmanaged.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The locale code. Shop locales have no GID.
- `name` (String) English display name, such as `French`.
- `primary` (Boolean) Whether this is the shop's primary locale.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <locale code>, case-sensitive
terraform import shopify_shop_locale.fr fr
terraform import shopify_shop_locale.brazil pt-BR
```
